basic_info.description: Located in sunny Noe Valley/Glen Park this move-in-ready 1BR/1BA condo has a great flexible floorplan. Walk downstairs to the bonus garden room, perfect for work-from-home days, art studio or personal gym. In the garage there is a dedicated 1/car parking, storage and laundry facilities. This stylish home blends modern comfort with retro charm- boasting refinished hardwood floors, a cozy gas fireplace, and abundant natural light throughout its classic open layout.  Step outside to a large backyard oasis, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The unbeatable location puts you just steps from local shops, cafes, schools, Slow Sanchez Street, and the Upper Noe Rec Center and dog park.  Commuting is a breeze with easy access to MUNI, BART, tech shuttles, and freeways (I-280 & 101). You're also within walking distance of Bernal Heights, Glen Park, and Mission.  A rare combination of charm, flexibility, and location--ideal for today's connected urban lifestyle.
